A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same WET research work, with readable main text, equations, figures, tables and complete Appendices A-C. The material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original paraphrasing-attack and WET experiments, including Tables 2-3 and the analyses in Appendices B-C.

after.justification: v2 retains the original attack, defence and ablation results reported in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The paraphrase-averaging attack and WET's matrix construction, normalization and pseudoinverse verification remain unchanged in Section 3 and Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions use Enron, SST2, MIND and AG News, with the same GPT-3.5, DIPPER and NLLB attack scenarios and appendix test coverage.

E2.justification: EmbMarker, WARDEN and the unwatermarked controls remain in the same reported comparisons. No comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: Table 7 corrects the final four-dataset block's reported BERT size from Base to Large. Appendix B.5 already describes small, base and large models in both versions, so this corrects a stated setting rather than establishing a new experiment or rerun. Other protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The same sensitivity, training-size, model-size, noise, verification-sample, matrix-construction and obfuscation analyses remain in Appendices B-C. Table 7's label correction adds no analysis or evidence.

E5.justification: The uncertainty reporting in Tables 2, 3 and 5 is unchanged. No run-count, seed, confidence-interval or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted trends are unchanged, including WET's 100% AUC throughout Table 3. Table 7 retains every score while correcting its model-size label; no new performance measurements or findings are reported.

T1.justification: Theorem 1 and its proof, the mathematical definitions and equations, and Appendix B.1's assumptions and watermark-weight derivation are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements and conclusion retain the same claims about paraphrasing vulnerabilities and WET's utility and robustness. The edits to Section 4.5 do not strengthen or narrow those claims.

C2.justification: The interpretations of text-length effects and matrix behavior are retained, as are limitations concerning single-row recovery and classification-only utility evaluation. The limitations text merely reflows across pages.

D1.justification: Appendix A retains the same prompts, hyperparameters, hardware/software details and code/data statements. The existing code link is unchanged; the new acknowledgements add support credits rather than implementation information.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion and positioning relative to prior watermarking methods are unchanged. Reference entries shift across pages without additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 fixes the malformed opening sentence of Section 4.4, lightly edits the performance paragraph in Section 4.5 and adds an Acknowledgement section. The scientific narrative and overall organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 7's Size label is corrected, and the prose edits and acknowledgements cause limited figure, paragraph and reference reflow. Figure content, table structures and numbering are otherwise retained.

improvement.justification: Changing Table 7's duplicated Base label to Large resolves its inconsistency with Appendix B.5 and clarifies the model-size results. Small prose corrections also improve readability. These are limited gains; the scientific evidence, theory and conclusions remain unchanged.
